notes: Sepolia launch of Swarmlings (LING) paired with native ETH (on Ethereum mainnet the same code pairs with IMD). Swarmlings is a DN404 token: its zero-argument constructor deploys its NFT contract (SwarmlingsMirror) and mints exactly 1e27 to msg.sender with skipNFT set; every whole 300,000 LING held by a wallet is one Swarmling NFT (3,333 max), minted and burned automatically; contracts skip NFTs unless they opt in, so the factory, PoolManager and distributor never hold any. No admin, proxy, pause, mint after construction, or fee on transfer; owner() only names the marketplace collection editor and has no power in the contracts. SwarmlingsHook takes the PoolManager and the token; flags 0x10CC. The first pool pairing LING with the token's rewardCurrency at static fee 12500 becomes launchPool (tick spacing 60 requested); other tiers and dynamic fees are ignored. A 1.25% fee in the paired currency on every buy and sell goes entirely to NFT holders, streamed over 24 hours, on top of the pool's 1.25% LP fee. NFT sales carry a 5% ERC-2981 creator fee to the token (half to holders, half to DEV 0x92cEf4823119f3332A85A39023eEbA01a06890c4) with OpenSea's fixed transfer validator. initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96 for about 50,000,000 LING per ETH (a 20 ETH opening cap, the Sepolia policy); use the launcher's policy price if it differs. Requested economics: poolBps 9000, so no allocation goes to the requester (an EOA allocation of 100M LING would mint 333 NFTs inside the launch transaction). Art comes from an immutable renderer at the same CREATE2 address on every chain (0x8d79e6677FA6E52190B39096f8496628811D8281, source in renderer/); until it has code, tokenURI returns a minimal valid JSON. See README.md and docs/.
